title: Thai PM Anutin plays saxophone at IMF–World Bank reception
summary: Thai Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul played the saxophone at a government reception attended by about 3,000 guests in Bangkok last Friday (October 16), welcoming international financial leaders…

blocks.text: Thai Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul played the saxophone at a government reception attended by about 3,000 guests in Bangkok last Friday (October 16), welcoming international financial leaders with music and a message about the economic opportunities offered by Thai food, culture and hospitality. Government spokesman Ekkapob Pianpises said Anutin presided over the Thai Government Reception
